text:
In the map below, those states in the Northeast aren’t blue for the reason you probably think they are. Same with the red shade in the “flyover states.”
No, this isn’t another illustration of the political leanings of our divided country — all that blue in the South should have been your first clue. This is a look at the biggest revenue earner in each state, created by cost-estimating website HowMuch.net :
The data comes from company filings in 2017, the latest year all the information is available, along with private company figures from S&P Capital IQ.
The map shows each state sized to reflect the revenue of the leading company based there. The redder the state, the bigger the revenue. Here’s a breakdown of the top 10 states ranked by revenue earned by their largest companies:
